title: Blast from the past, pixel art side scroller with gore.
author: MedicineTime6681
selftext:
**I’m 51 today, and childhood me (11 years old) wrote the brief for this game in a old schoolbook i found a month ago. I used both some of my own coding skills but i am really bad at it, ChatGPT for refining my art (that was first made by hand in photoshop), Chatgpt created the transparent PNG´s and refined my pixel graphics. Claude for coding (Claude code).**  
  
**Game:**  
[**https://andersprintz.itch.io/blast-from-the-past**](https://andersprintz.itch.io/blast-from-the-past)

That’s *Blast from the Past*. Making it feels like spending time with young me, the kid I used to be, haha finally saying: “Let’s actually build it & ship it.”  Still a work in progress, the vector people are "placeholders" to be replaced bt pixelart, but I think it’s playable, plz try it out.. ❤️

comments.author: MedicineTime6681
comments.body: Updated with full pixel art, would love to know if it lags or not. Please provide your spec if you try it out, and performance! Thank you 🙏

replies.body: Thank you, Robocop was one of my fav movies when I grew up. 😊🙏ED-209 was in my nightmares. 😂
